url.description: A pre-signed URL pointing to the input template file.

source.description: Contains metadata about the source of the input template.

type.description: The value of the template type. This is the same value being used in the describe template API request call.

fonts.description: Array of fonts to be used in the template.

config.description: Configuration options for the render request

handleMissingFonts.description: How to handle missing fonts. 'fail' will cause the render to fail, 'use_default' will use Premiere Pro fallback behavior

variations.description: List of variations. Each variation will return an output template with variation applied on the input.

presetIds.description: Array of preset IDs to be applied on the variation (received from preset endpoint). Currently supports only 1 preset.

elements.description: List of elements in the template. Each element contains controls that can be modified

controls.description: List of controls. These are control objects received from the describe template API which are then passed to the render API with modified properties.

mediaType.description: MIME type of the media file (e.g., video/mp4, image/png).

options.description: Minimum and maximum values for slider controls.

jobId.description: Unique identifier for the render job.

statusUrl.description: URL to poll for the status of the rendering job.

message.description: Error message when job status is failed.

percentCompleted.description: Percentage of job completed, as a string.

outputs.description: Array of output files with destination URLs and variation indices.

url.description: URL from which the rendered video can be downloaded.

variationId.description: ID of the variation that was rendered.

presetId.description: ID of the preset that was used for rendering.

errors.description: Array of errors for failed variations (only present when status is partially_succeeded).

presetId.description: ID of the preset that was used for the failed variation.

uploadRequired.description: Whether the font needs to be uploaded in the render request.
